title: Turning into an Outdated Mobile Game for Whales
body: This app used to be amazing, but recent changes in monetization lock all series behind a timer of 1 chapter per 24 hours. It’s super disruptive and makes it hard to get immersed in the stories. Further it’s the type of time from mobile games a decade ago where the timer for the next chapter doesn’t start until you open the new chapter. They are actively opposing flow states, which seems really stupid for a reading app, but here we are. My last gripe is when they implemented the system,you lost access to all the stories you were in the middle of. I have 3 stories I was trying to read. One thinks I need to wait 150 days (assuming perfect check-ins) to continue. Another wants me to wait 552 days. It’s just super user unfriendly. I’m hating the decrease in quality of service.

title: Karma system is fair
body: The app doesn’t force you to pay money or shove ads down your throat. Daily logins and missions give you 10+ Keys for free every day. If you want to pay to buy Karma, there are no predatory bulk discounts encouraging you to pay the maximum amount for the best price—all options are 1,000 Karma = $5. This model is simple and fair for consumers, the best I’ve seen in the industry.

title: Probably one of the only good apps for reading
body: 1. It’s official translation meaning you don’t have to worry about the series suddenly stopping 2. Despite the fact that binge reading a new series is harder then it used to be it’s not bad, staying caught up on a small number of series is incredibly simple 3. It looks nice, some reading apps i have tried are filled with bad design decisions and terrible ui but this is a balance between modern and simple 4. The lack of pop up ads, video ads and trying to force you to spend money is nice Overall this app is the perfect balance for people that want to read Korean and Chinese novels without the pain that comes with some official or unofficial translation sites and apps

title: Great App
body: Lots to love about this app, I’ve been using it for almost a year now and I’ve been happily subscribed for around 8 months. Downloads are storage efficient since it’s all just text, the colored themes are easy on the eyes, and the text to speech is amazing once you get used to it being a bit robotic. The library may not be complete with ALL of the books you want, but there are plenty of great ones to choose from. 9/10 app with the only necessary changes being some simple bug fixes like not requiring users to sign back in when they come back online from an offline session.
